caption:
I don't sell anymore. My personal brand does the selling for me.

Stop posting only your work. Show the owner, the clients, the employees. Make characters out of your team.

Comment IDEAS and I'll send you 10 video ideas you can film this week.
why: Opens with Joseph's own claim that he doesn't have to sell anymore, then gives the practical tip from the video (show the owner and make characters out of employees), and IDEAS fits because the video teaches business owners what to post.
